title: Draft a "Zedu for Career Switchers" Blog Post
description: Many bootcamp students are career switchers. Write a blog post aimed at prospective bootcamp students, explaining how Zedu helps them stay organized during an intensive 8-week program.

acceptedWorkstreams.title: An 8-week career-switcher guide built around the questions they actually search
acceptedWorkstreams.description: Write one source-backed blog post for people starting an intensive bootcamp while changing careers. It should answer the practical questions: how to keep coursework, deadlines, mentor feedback and job-search tasks in one place; what to do in week one; and how to avoid losing files in chat. Use only features visible on zedu.chat, link to the relevant product pages, and include a title under 60 characters and a meta description under 160. One task: research the query set, write the post, and deliver the copy with sources and internal links.
